_comment: Greybox dungeon-kit asset manifest for KhaozEngine.Showcase. heightMeters is the real-world height the loader normalizes each mesh to (origin dropped to the base). Every piece here is authored at its exact final size so the loader applies no rescale. Generated by tools/DungeonKitGen at cell=3/floorHeight=6 (dotnet run --project tools/DungeonKitGen -- KhaozEngine.Showcase/assets/dungeon 3 6), matching RoomDungeon's DungeonConfig (CellSizeMeters=3, FloorHeightMeters=6), see CREDITS.md. Ids match DungeonKitMap.Greybox() (KhaozEngine.Dungeon).
